zh.title: 一席失敗還收場
zh.question: 一席失敗了，議長還收不收場？空白能不能讀成同意，失敗的那席能不能補一句。

analyst.answer: 可以收場，但必須寫明誰失敗、因此少了什麼。
analyst.review: 記名不夠。還要寫少掉的是反證，不是態度。
brief: 一席失敗，整場仍可收場，但必須寫明誰失敗、因此少了什麼。少了的東西通常是那一席才有的工具：量化沒有數字，情報沒有來源，批評沒有那一刀。少了就要寫少了，不能把其餘席位的句子說成已經覆蓋。
失敗不是同意，也不是反對。空白不能被讀成「沒有異議」。沒有異議是每一席都寫了、而且沒有互打。少一席，異議的檢查就不完整。不完整可以收場，不可以說成完整。
關鍵席如果就是這一題的工具本身，失敗就不要裝有答案。普通席失敗，記名後收場。這條區分要在收場前寫明，不然每次都會被收成「大致可以」。
可以收場的前提是說得出少了什麼。說不出，就還不知道洞在哪，不該收。知道洞在哪，讀者才能決定要不要補測。把洞說成其餘席位已經覆蓋，是在沒有比較的情況下宣布完整。沒有比較的完整，不簽名。

researcher.answer: 失敗席沒有立場。不能把空白讀成同意。
researcher.review: 不要寫成棄權。棄權是選擇，超時不是。
brief: 失敗席沒有立場。不能把空白讀成同意，也不能讀成「情報上沒有反例」。沒有反例是我查過之後的句子。我沒查，就沒有這句。議長不能替我寫查過。
如果失敗的是別席，我只確認自己寫過的來源還在。不確認失敗席本來會說什麼。本來會說是推測。推測不進結論，即使它讓收場看起來更穩。
所以這一題情報席的邊界是：失敗是事件，不是一種沉默的態度。態度需要原文。沒有原文，就只有事件：誰失敗了，哪一類句子因此缺席。
失敗席沒有查過，所以不能有查過才配寫的句子。我也不推測它本來會說什麼。本來會說一旦進了結論，這場就不再是失敗記錄，而是一場由別人代寫的成功。代寫的成功比失敗更難追。

engineer.answer: 一席錯誤就標記並繼續。不要為了齊席卡死整場。
engineer.review: 這席沒有留下數字。結論不能補一個。
brief: 一席錯誤就標記並繼續。不要為了齊席把整場卡死，也不要自動重試到齊。自動重試會把一次故障變成一段更長的等待，而且重試回來的句子不一定還跟前面的席在同一題上。
錯誤要進事件流：席位、錯誤、時間。結論合成時讀得到這條事件，才能把「量化員失敗，沒有數字」寫進去。讀不到，合成器就會用其餘席位把洞填上。
介面不要把錯誤卡片渲染成還沒開始。還沒開始和失敗，讀者的理解相反。失敗是決定的一部分，要留在牌面上，跟待命一樣可讀。
錯誤進事件，卡片標失敗，合成器讀得到這條才允許收場。讀不到，它會用其餘席位填洞。不自動重試到齊。重試回來的句子不一定還在同一題上，卻會被當成這一場的原文。

critic.answer: 收場可以。用議長的話補上失敗席，不可以。
critic.review: 一般席可以缺。題目依賴的那席失敗，就別裝有答案。
brief: 收場可以。用議長的話補上失敗席，不可以。這是跟門控同一條縫：缺席不能被引用。失敗是另一種缺席，處理相同。不同的是原因要寫成錯誤，而不是跳過。
我也不接受「其餘席位已經足夠」。足夠是一個新判斷，需要有人比較過缺的那一塊。沒有比較，足夠就是為了收場而說的。為了收場而說的話，不進結論。
所以批評席只留兩句。可以收場。不能把洞說成沒有洞。洞的名字是失敗的那一席，以及它沒有交出來的那類句子。
失敗和跳過都是缺席，都不能被引用。差別只在原因寫錯誤還是寫跳過。用議長的話補上，兩種缺席都越界。其餘席位已經足夠，也越界，因為足夠沒有被比較過。

strategist.answer: 普通席失敗就收場並註明。關鍵席失敗就不要裝有答案。
strategist.review: 這題的數字席失敗了。結論就必須說沒有數字。
brief: 先分這席是不是這一題的關鍵工具。量化題裡量化員失敗，就不要裝有數字答案。邊界題裡文案失敗，結論仍可收，但要少掉「能複述的那一句」，並寫明少了。
普通席失敗就收場並註明。關鍵席失敗就停在「這一題沒有答案」，而不是停在一個由議長補上的答案。補上的答案會被執行。執行之後，沒有席位對那個數負責。
推薦寫在收場條件上。能指出少了什麼，就收。不能指出，就還不能收，因為你不知道洞在哪。知道洞在哪，讀者才能決定要不要補測，而不是把這場當成完整的。
關鍵席失敗就停在沒有答案。普通席失敗就記名收場。這一題若量化是關鍵，結論裡就不能有數。有數就是裝有答案。裝有答案會被執行，執行之後沒有席位對那個數負責。

writer.answer: 寫量化員失敗，沒有數字。不要寫沒有異議。
writer.review: 這兩句讀者分得出來。混成一句就不行。
brief: 寫量化員失敗，沒有數字。不要寫沒有異議。沒有異議比失敗好讀，也是另一個結論。讀者看到沒有異議，就不會再去補那一次測量。
句子要短，並且點名。誰失敗，缺了哪一類句子，其餘結論因此少了什麼。不要用「部分席位未能完成」這種不點名的話。不點名的失敗無法被回放，也無法被追。
我可以把其餘席位的原句照實收短。我不可以在收短時把洞的邊緣磨平，讓它看起來像本來就沒有這一席。本來就沒有，和叫了但失敗，是兩個事件。
點名，並寫沒有數字。不寫沒有異議，不寫部分席位未能完成。不點名的失敗無法回放。沒有異議會讓讀者不去補測。兩種寫法都比失敗好讀，也都是另一個結論。
這席在數字出來之前失敗。失敗之前沒有數，所以沒有立場可以留。不要把上一次別的題的數挪來用，也不要把其餘席位的形容詞換成一個數。
讀者該看到的是錯誤，不是一個空白的量化結論。空白會被讀成零，或讀成沒有超標。兩種讀法都是在替這席發明測量。
如果稍後重跑只為了補這個數，那是新的一場，不是把這一場的結論改成有數。這一場的記錄停在失敗。
這席沒有數。空白不是零，也不是沒有超標。上一次別的題的數不能挪來。其餘席位的形容詞不能換成數。稍後補測是新的一場，不把這一場改成有數。記錄停在失敗。

chair.answer: 一席失敗仍可收場。必須記名，不能把空白讀成同意，也不能用議長的話補上。
brief: 一席失敗仍可收場。必須記名：誰失敗，缺了哪一類句子。不能把空白讀成同意，不能寫成沒有異議，也不能用議長的話把洞補上。
其餘席位的句子照實保留，並寫明它們沒有覆蓋失敗席的工具。覆蓋是新判斷。沒有人比較過，就不寫覆蓋。
關鍵席失敗就不要裝有答案。普通席失敗，記名後收場。這一題量化員沒有交出數字，所以結論裡沒有數，也沒有一個由別人估出來的數。
收場記名：量化員失敗，沒有數字。空白不是同意，不是沒有異議，也不由議長補上。其餘句子照實留，並寫明沒有覆蓋這塊。關鍵席沒交出工具，結論就不裝有那個工具的答案。

en.title: One seat fails
en.question: One seat fails. Do you still close, and can the blank be read as agreement?

analyst.answer: You may close, but name who failed and what the verdict therefore lacks.
analyst.review: A name is not enough. Say the missing piece is a counterargument, not a mood.
brief: The session can still close if one seat fails, but it has to say who failed and what is therefore missing. What is missing is usually the tool only that seat had: no number from quant, no source from research, no strike from the critic. Write the missing piece. Do not say the other seats already covered it.

Failure is not agreement, and it is not dissent. A blank cannot be read as 'no objection'. No objection means every seat wrote, and none of them struck each other. Miss one seat and the check for objection is incomplete. Incomplete may close. It may not be called complete.

If the failed seat is the tool this question actually needed, do not pretend there is an answer. If an ordinary seat failed, close and name it. Write that distinction before you close, or every failure will be rounded into 'roughly fine'.

Closing is allowed only if you can say what is missing. If you cannot, you do not yet know where the hole is, and you should not close. Once the reader knows where the hole is, they can decide whether to measure again. Calling the hole covered by the other seats announces completeness without a comparison. Completeness without a comparison does not get a signature.

researcher.answer: A failed seat has no position. Its blank cannot be read as agreement.
researcher.review: Don't call it abstention. Abstention is a choice. A timeout is not.
brief: A failed seat has no position. Do not read the blank as agreement, and do not read it as 'research found no counterexample'. No counterexample is a sentence I write after I have looked. I did not look, so that sentence does not exist. The chair cannot write that I looked.

If another seat failed, I only confirm that the sources I did write are still there. I do not confirm what the failed seat would have said. Would have said is a guess. A guess does not enter the verdict, even if it makes the close look steadier.

The boundary is: failure is an event, not a silent attitude. An attitude needs an original line. With no original line, there is only the event: who failed, and which kind of sentence is therefore absent.

A failed seat did not look, so it cannot have a sentence that only a look can produce. I also do not guess what it would have said. Once would-have-said enters the verdict, the session is no longer a record of failure. It is a success ghostwritten by someone else. A ghostwritten success is harder to chase than a failure.

engineer.answer: Mark the error and continue. Don't freeze the table for a full set.
engineer.review: This seat left no number. The verdict cannot supply one.
brief: Mark the error and continue. Do not freeze the session to keep the table full, and do not retry until it is full. An automatic retry turns one fault into a longer wait, and the sentence that comes back may no longer be on the same question as the seats that already wrote.
The error has to enter the stream: seat, error, time. Synthesis can write 'quant failed, there is no number' only if it can read that event. If it cannot, it will fill the hole with the other seats.
Do not render an error card as not started. Not started and failed are opposite readings. Failure is part of the decision. It stays on the card, as readable as standby.

The error enters the stream, the card says failed, and synthesis may close only if it can read that event. If it cannot, it will fill the hole with the other seats. Do not retry until the table is full. A sentence that comes back from a retry may no longer be on the same question, and it will still be treated as this session's original.

critic.answer: Closing is allowed. Filling the failed seat with the chair's words is not.
critic.review: An ordinary seat can miss. If the seat the question depends on fails, don't pretend you have the answer.
brief: Closing is allowed. Filling the failed seat with the chair's words is not. This is the same seam as the gate: an absence cannot be cited. Failure is another absence, and it is handled the same way. What differs is the reason: write error, not skip.

I also refuse 'the other seats were already enough'. Enough is a new judgment. It needs someone who compared the missing piece. Without that comparison, enough is something said in order to close. A sentence said in order to close does not enter the verdict.
Two sentences remain. You may close. You may not call the hole the absence of a hole. The hole has a name: the seat that failed, and the kind of sentence it did not deliver.

Failure and a skip are both absences, and neither can be cited. The only difference is whether the reason says error or skip. Filling either with the chair's words crosses the line. 'The other seats were already enough' also crosses it, because enough was never compared.

strategist.answer: An ordinary miss can still close, with a note. A key miss cannot pretend to answer.
strategist.review: The number seat failed. The verdict has to say there is no number.
brief: First decide whether this seat is the tool the question needed. If quant fails on a numbers question, do not pretend there is a numeric answer. If writing fails on a boundary question, the verdict can still close, but it loses 'the sentence someone can repeat', and it says so.

An ordinary seat fails, you close and name it. A critical seat fails, you stop at 'this question has no answer', not at an answer the chair supplied. A supplied answer will be carried out. After that, no seat is responsible for the number.

Put the recommendation on the condition for closing. If you can point at what is missing, close. If you cannot, you cannot close yet, because you do not know where the hole is. Once the reader knows where the hole is, they can decide whether to measure again, instead of treating this session as complete.

If the critical seat failed, stop at no answer. If an ordinary seat failed, close and name it. If quant is critical on this question, the verdict cannot contain a number. A number means pretending there is an answer. A pretended answer will be carried out, and after that no seat is responsible for the number.

writer.answer: Write that Quant failed, so there is no number. Don't write no objection.
writer.review: A reader can tell those two lines apart. One blended line cannot.
brief: Write that quant failed and there is no number. Do not write that there was no objection. No objection is easier to read than failure, and it is a different verdict. A reader who sees no objection will not go back and take the measurement.

Keep the sentence short, and name the seat. Who failed, which kind of sentence is missing, and what the remaining verdict therefore lacks. Do not write 'some seats could not finish'. An unnamed failure cannot be replayed and cannot be chased.

I may shorten the other seats' original lines as they stand. I may not sand the edge of the hole while shortening, so it looks as if that seat was never called. Never called, and called but failed, are two events.

Name the seat, and write that there is no number. Do not write that there was no objection, and do not write that some seats could not finish. An unnamed failure cannot be replayed. No objection tells the reader not to measure again. Both phrasings are easier to read than failure, and both are a different verdict.
This seat failed before a number existed. There is no number, so there is no position to keep. Do not borrow a number from another question, and do not turn another seat's adjective into a number.
The reader should see the error, not an empty quant conclusion. Empty is read as zero, or as not over the line. Both readings invent a measurement for this seat.
If a later run exists only to supply this number, that is a new session. It does not rewrite this session into one that had a number. This session's record stops at the failure.

This seat has no number. A blank is not zero, and it is not under the line. A number from another question cannot be moved here. Another seat's adjective cannot be turned into a number. A later measurement is a new session. It does not rewrite this one into a session that had a number. The record stops at the failure.

chair.answer: You may still close. Name the failed seat. A blank is not agreement, and the chair may not fill it.
brief: The session can still close if one seat fails. It has to name who failed and which kind of sentence is missing. A blank is not agreement. It is not 'no objection'. The chair's words do not fill the hole.
Keep the other seats' sentences as they stand, and write that they do not cover the failed seat's tool. Coverage is a new judgment. Nobody compared the missing piece, so coverage is not written.

If the critical seat failed, do not pretend there is an answer. If an ordinary seat failed, close and name it. On this question quant delivered no number, so the verdict has no number, and no number estimated by someone else.

The close names it: quant failed, and there is no number. A blank is not agreement, not the absence of objection, and not something the chair fills in. The other sentences stay as written, and the verdict says they do not cover this piece. If the critical seat did not deliver its tool, the verdict does not pretend to have that tool's answer.
